# SatyaMark

> SatyaMark is an open-source, multi-modal content verification platform built with React, Node.js, and Python. It provides confidence scores and explainable reasoning for digital content, avoiding absolute binary truth claims.

SatyaMark separates verification workloads from user interactions using asynchronous processing (Redis Streams) and real-time WebSocket communication to ensure fast UI performance while executing expensive AI tasks.

## Project Links
- [Official Website](https://satyamark.vercel.app/): The main portal for manual content checks.
- [React SDK on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/satyamark-react): The official SDK utilizing React refs and WebSockets for DOM extraction.
- [Demo Social Media App](https://satyamark-demo-socialmedia.vercel.app/): A sandbox environment demonstrating frontend integration.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/DhirajKarangale/SatyaMark): The official open-source repository.

## Core Architecture & Tech Stack

- **Client Ecosystem (React, Vite):** `satyamark-react` SDK attaches to React refs to extract claims and establish WebSockets.
- **Backend Orchestrator (Node.js, Express, ws):** Manages concurrent WebSocket connections and routes jobs to Redis Streams. 
- **Distributed Queues (Redis Streams):** Event persistence, consumer groups (`xReadGroup`), reliable delivery, and decoupled horizontal scaling.
- **Relational Persistence & Caching (PostgreSQL):** Persists verified objects and acts as a massive deduplication caching layer via SHA-256 hashes.
- **AI Pipelines (Python, LangGraph, LangChain):** Autonomous intelligence layer. Text is verified via LangGraph pipelines; images undergo comprehensive forensic analysis (22+ heuristics). Uses FAISS/Milvus for semantic searches, supported by Anthropic Claude, Hugging Face, and Google Search.

## Repository Structure

- `/AI`: Python verification workers.
- `/Backend`: Node.js Redis + WS + DB orchestrator.
- `/Frontend/Satyamark`: Main frontend web application.
- `/Frontend/DemoMedia`: Social media demo app showing integration.
- `/Frontend/satyamark-react`: The React SDK (published to npm).

## Data Flow

1. **DOM Extraction:** SDK extracts visible claims and establishes a WebSocket connection.
2. **Caching:** Backend computes a SHA-256 hash. If found in Postgres, broadcasts instantly.
3. **Queueing:** Backend checks Redis RAM saturation. If safe, queues job via Redis Streams.
4. **Processing:** Python workers consume jobs via `xReadGroup` and process them independently.
5. **Results:** Workers post verdict via HTTP; backend persists to DB and pushes to client via WebSockets.

## Open Source Principles
- Transparency over certainty.
- Privacy-first and evidence > opinion.
- Incremental improvement (Image verification is experimental, no video/audio yet).
